title: Dispatch: 19.1.8 known-finding regression discrimination (attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-o9bd.19.1.8 per its DESIGN field (population, METHOD steps 1-4, EXCLUSIONS). Read AGENTS.md 'Permanent Test Evidence' and docs/importer-fix-protocol.md 'Test changes' first: you may strengthen or replace a narrow assertion with a stronger invariant that preserves the original regression intent; you may never weaken one.
Steps:
1. For each row in the DESIGN population, read its registry entry (docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json), its owning bead's close reason / repair PR (bd show <owner>; gh pr view <n> --json title,mergeCommit,files), and find the permanent evidence test(s) (grep the test tree for the alias, the record keys involved, and the repair PR's test files).
2. Discrimination check: find the repair's merge commit; take the parent (pre-repair) committed pack: git show <merge>^1:packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json > a temp file OUTSIDE the worktree (use your scratch dir under /home/jhbongaarts/.cache/tmp/...), and evaluate the evidence's predicate against it (a throwaway node/tsx script reimplementing exactly the test's assertion, or temporarily pointing the test at the temp file in a scratch run you then revert). Record PASS-on-defective (weak) or FAIL-on-defective (discriminating). For rows whose repair was importer-only with no pack change visible in records.json (e.g. provenance/manifest artifacts), use the corresponding generated artifact (field-provenance.json, source-coverage.json, manifest) the same way. If a row's defect cannot be reconstructed, record it as UNEVALUABLE with the reason (it must not be counted as passing).
3. Fix WEAK/MISSING rows with one generalized predicate per defect class over the justified population (never one test per example); retire REDUNDANT evidence only where a named stronger test demonstrably covers the same claim. Do not touch tests outside the population.
4. Run npm run verify:worktree before committing; must pass.
REPORT (bd notes): the per-row table: row | evidence test | pre-repair sha used | result | action; plus every test changed with preserves/strengthens/replaces.
DO NOT: add a committed per-finding index or registry field; change pack/importer code; touch freeze-manifest hashes.
